title: FATHER GOD, LIFT THE PRESSURE I FEEL IN THIS SEASON
text: I want you to share this prayer with everyone you know. Send it to your family, send it to your friends, your colleagues at work, people in your church, people in your fellowship. There are people under pressure right now, and when this prayer gets into their hands, the spirit of God will lift burdens that have been crushing them for years. Don't keep this to yourself. The Bible says in Galatians 6:2, "Bear ye one another's burdens and so fulfill the law of Christ." When you share this prayer, you are participating in the ministry of burden bearing. You are becoming an instrument in the hand of God to bring relief to someone who is suffocating under the weight of life's pressures. So, right [music] now, before we even go into this prayer, I want you to make a decision that you will share this with at least 10 people today. The Lord will remember your compassion, and when you come under pressure, he will raise intercessors for you in Jesus' name. Now, let me talk to you this morning about pressure. There is a difference between trials and pressure. Trials are external circumstances that test your faith, but pressure is that internal crushing weight that makes you feel like you cannot breathe anymore. Pressure is when the enemy doesn't just attack you from outside, but he creates a psychological, emotional, and spiritual compression in your soul that makes you feel like you are being squeezed from every direction. Some of you listening to me right now, you wake up every morning, and the first thing you feel is that heaviness. Before your feet even touch the ground, you already feel overwhelmed. You feel like you are carrying a weight that is too heavy for your shoulders. The Bible says in Matthew 11:28, "Come unto me, all ye that labor and are heavy laden, and I will give you rest." Jesus is not just talking about physical tiredness. He's talking about the weariness that comes from carrying burdens that were never meant for you to carry. There are pressures that come from the enemy, and there are pressures that come from our own choices, and there are pressures that come simply because we live in a fallen world. But regardless of where the pressure comes from, I want you to know this morning that God specializes in lifting pressure. The Bible says in Psalm 55:22, "Cast thy burden upon the Lord, and he shall sustain thee. He shall never suffer the righteous to be moved." The word cast there means to violently throw off. God is saying, "Stop carrying what I never asked you to carry." Some of you have been under financial pressure for so long that you have started to believe that this is just your portion in life. Some of you have been under marital pressure, health pressure, emotional pressure, ministry pressure, and you have reached a place where you don't even pray about it anymore because you think this is just how life is going to be. But I am here as a prophet this morning to tell you that the season of pressure is coming to an [music] end in your life in the name of Jesus. Let me show you something from the scriptures. In 2 Corinthians 1:8, Paul says, "For we would not, brethren, have you ignorant of our trouble which came to us in Asia, that we were pressed out of measure above strength, insomuch that we despaired even of life." Did you hear that? The Apostle Paul, the greatest missionary in the New Testament, said there was a time when he was under so much pressure that he despaired even of life. He was saying, "I didn't think I was going to make it. The pressure was beyond my ability to handle." But look at what he says in verse 9. "But we had the sentence of death in ourselves, that we should not trust in ourselves, but in God, which raiseth the dead." Paul is saying that the purpose of that intense pressure was to bring him to a place where he stopped trusting in his own strength [music] and started trusting completely in God. Some of you, the pressure you are under right now is not meant to destroy you. It is meant to reposition your trust. God is saying, "I allowed this pressure so that you would stop leaning on your connections, your wisdom, your strategies, and start leaning completely on me. When you come to the end of yourself, you discover the beginning of God's limitless power." The very thing that feels like it is crushing you is actually the thing that God is using to teach you how to access a dimension of his power [music] that you have never experienced before. This is why James 1:2-4 says, "My brethren, count it all joy when ye fall into divers temptations, knowing this, that the trying of your faith worketh patience. But let patience have her perfect work, that ye may be perfect and entire, wanting nothing." The pressure is working something in you that would never have been worked in you during seasons of ease. But now, let me prophesy to you. While God can use pressure to refine you, there is also a demonic dimension of pressure that is not from God, and that pressure must be broken by the power of prayer. There are satanic pressures that are designed to crush your destiny, to suffocate your vision, to make you give up on the promises of God. The devil knows that if he can keep you under sustained pressure long enough, you will eventually collapse spiritually. This is why Ephesians 6:12 says, "For we wrestle not against flesh and blood, but against principalities, against powers, against the rulers [music] of the darkness of this world, against spiritual wickedness in high places." Some of the pressure you are feeling is not just life happening. It is spiritual warfare. There are demonic assignments against [music] your peace, against your mind, against your family, against your finances, and those assignments must be canceled this morning by the authority of the name of Jesus. I want you to understand the strategy of the enemy. The devil doesn't always attack you with big, obvious things. Sometimes his most effective [music] weapon is sustained, low-level pressure that gradually wears you down. It's the constant financial struggle that never seems to get better. It's the relationship tension that never fully resolves. It's the health issue that keeps coming back. It's the anxiety that wakes you up at 3:00 a.m. every single night. The enemy knows that if he can keep you in a state of constant stress and pressure, he can steal your joy, steal your faith, steal your effectiveness in the kingdom of God. But Colossians 2:15 says that Jesus, having spoiled principalities and powers, he made a show of them openly, triumphing over them in it. Jesus has already defeated every force that is trying to keep you under pressure. The victory is already won. What we are doing in prayer this morning is enforcing that victory over your life and over your situation. Now, I want to talk to you about the source of divine relief. When God lifts pressure from your life, he doesn't just remove the circumstance, he gives you grace to carry what remains. 2 Corinthians 12:9 says, "And he said unto me, 'My grace is sufficient for thee, for my strength is made perfect in weakness.' Sometimes God removes the pressure entirely, and sometimes he gives you supernatural grace to walk through the pressure without being crushed by it. Either way, you win. Either the mountain moves, or God gives you the strength to climb it without getting weary. This is the beauty of serving a God who knows exactly what you need. He knows when to deliver you from the fire, and he knows when to walk with you through the fire and make sure you don't get burned. Let me tell you what happens when God lifts pressure from your life. First, your mind becomes clear again. Pressure creates mental fog. It makes you unable to think clearly, unable to make good decisions, unable to hear the voice of God. But when God lifts that pressure, suddenly you have clarity. You can think again. You can plan again. You can hear God's voice again. Second, your strength returns. Pressure drains your physical, emotional, and spiritual energy. But Isaiah 40:31 says, "But they that wait upon the Lord shall renew their strength. They shall mount up with wings as eagles. They shall run and not be weary, and they shall walk and not faint." When God lifts pressure, he doesn't just stop at removing the burden. He renews your strength. You feel like yourself again. You feel alive again. Third, your joy returns. Nehemiah 8:10 says, "The joy of the Lord is your strength." Pressure steals joy, but when God shows up, joy comes flooding back into your spirit like a river. Some of you need to hear this. The pressure you are under is not a reflection of God's displeasure with you. Sometimes we think that if we are going through hard times, it means God is angry with us or we have done something wrong, but that is not always true. Even Jesus, the perfect Son of God, experienced pressure. In the Garden of Gethsemane, he was under so much pressure that the Bible says he sweat great drops of blood. That is a medical condition called hematidrosis, [music] which happens when someone is under extreme stress. If Jesus experienced pressure, then we should not be surprised when we experience it, too. But just as the Father sent an angel to strengthen Jesus in the garden, the Father is going to send help to you in your season of pressure. Help is coming. Reinforcement is coming. Angels have been dispatched on your behalf right now as we pray. Now, let's go into prayer. But I want you to pray with authority. Don't pray like a victim. Pray like a victor. Jesus has already won the battle. You are not praying to beg God to do something he doesn't want to do. You are praying to align yourself with what he has already purposed to do in your life. You are enforcing the victory of Calvary over every area of pressure in your life. So, lift up your voice right now, wherever you are, and let's bombard heaven with prayers that will shift things in the realm of the spirit. Father, in the mighty name of Jesus, I come before your throne of grace this morning, and I thank you because you are the God who lifts [music] burdens. You are the God who breaks yolks. You are the God who delivers your people from every form of oppression. Your word says in Psalm 68:19, "Blessed be the Lord who daily loadeth us with benefits, even the God of our salvation." Father, you don't load us with burdens. You load us with benefits. Every burden that we carry that is not from you, we cast it at your feet right now in the name of Jesus. Father, I present before you every person listening to this prayer who is under financial pressure, who is under emotional pressure, who is under marital pressure, who is under health pressure, who is under spiritual pressure. Father, you see them, you know them by name, you know exactly what they're going through, and your word says in 1 Peter 5:7, "Casting all your care upon him, for he careth for you." Father, we are casting every care upon you right now. We are throwing off every heavy burden. We're releasing every weight that has been crushing us. Father, I pray for supernatural intervention right now in Jesus' name. Let your mighty hand move in situations that seem impossible, where doctors [music] have given negative reports. Father, release your healing power. Where bank accounts are empty. Father, release financial miracles. Where relationships are broken. Father, release restoration and reconciliation. Where minds are tormented with anxiety and fear. Father, release peace that passes all understanding. Your word says in Philippians 4:6-7, "Be careful for nothing, but in everything by prayer and supplication with thanksgiving, let your requests be made known unto God. And the peace of God which passeth all understanding shall keep your minds through Christ Jesus." Father, let that peace flood every heart right now. Let that peace guard every mind. Let that peace settle every troubled spirit. In the name of Jesus, I come against every demonic pressure that has been assigned against the people of God. Every satanic plot to crush destinies, I cancel it now by the blood of Jesus. Every witchcraft agenda to suffocate visions and dreams, I destroy it now by the fire of the Holy Ghost. Every ancestral curse that has been putting pressure on families from generation to generation, I break it now by the authority of the name of Jesus. The Bible says in Galatians 3:13, "Christ hath redeemed us from the curse of the law, being made a curse for us." We are redeemed from every curse. We are free from every generational bondage. We are delivered from every satanic oppression. So, right now, in the name of Jesus, I decree and declare that every yoke is broken, every chain is shattered, every prison door is opened, every stronghold is pulled down. Father, I pray for those who are under pressure because of delays in their lives. Delays in marriage, delays in childbearing, delays in business, delays in ministry, delays in academic pursuits. Father, your word says in Habakkuk 2:2-3, "For the vision is yet for an appointed time, but at the end it shall [music] speak and not lie. Though it tarry, wait for it, because it will surely come. It will not tarry." Father, we have been waiting, and the waiting has created pressure, but I pray that you would accelerate your purposes right now. Let delays turn into divine appointments. Let frustration turn into favor. Let every closed door that was supposed to open, open now by fire in Jesus' name. Let every blocked pathway become clear. Let every hindrance be removed. Let every obstacle be eliminated. I speak to the spirit of heaviness right now, and I command it to lift off the people of God in Jesus' name. Isaiah 61:1-3 says that God has given us the garment of praise [music] for the spirit of heaviness. Father, we put on that garment of praise right now. We choose to worship you in the midst of our pressure. We choose to magnify your name even though circumstances are difficult. We declare that you are faithful. We declare that you are mighty. We declare that you are able to do exceedingly abundantly above all that we ask or think according to the power that works in us. So, we lift our voices in praise, and as we praise you, every heavy burden must go. As we worship you, every oppressive weight must be lifted. As we magnify your name, every demonic pressure must be broken. Father, I pray specifically for those who are under mental and emotional pressure, those who are battling depression, anxiety, fear, worry, and stress. Father, you did not give us a spirit of fear, but of power, of love, and of a sound mind according to 2 Timothy 1:7. So, right now, I speak sound mind over every troubled mind. I speak peace over every anxious heart. I speak clarity over every confused thought. I command every spirit of torment to leave now in Jesus' name. Every voice of condemnation be silenced. Every thought of suicide be destroyed. Every feeling of hopelessness be replaced with hope. Every sense of worthlessness be replaced with the knowledge of how valuable you are to God. You are fearfully and wonderfully made. You are bought with a price. [music] You are the apple of God's eye. You are precious in his sight, and no weapon formed against your mind shall [music] prosper in Jesus' name. I pray for those who are under pressure in their marriages and relationships, where there is constant conflict. Father, release peace. Where there is unforgiveness, release the grace to forgive. Where there is betrayal and hurt, release healing and restoration. Where communication has broken down, release wisdom and understanding. Father, your word says in Mark 10:9, "What therefore God hath joined together, let not man put asunder." I pray that every marriage under attack right now will be fortified by your power. Every relationship that the enemy is trying to destroy, I decree and declare that it shall not be destroyed, but shall be stronger than ever before. Release love afresh. Release commitment afresh. Release unity afresh. Let couples begin to see each other the way you see them. Let them remember why they came together in the first place. Let the love that brought them together be rekindled by the fire of your spirit. Father, I lift up before you those who are under financial pressure, those who are struggling to pay bills, those who are in debt, those who are believing for jobs, those who are believing for business breakthroughs, those who are believing for financial miracles. Father, your word says in Philippians 4:19, "But my God shall supply all your need according to his riches in glory by Christ Jesus." You are not limited by the economy. You are not limited by the job market. You are not limited by what banks say or what the world says. You are God, and you own the cattle on a thousand hills. You can make a way where there is no way. So, right now, I speak open heavens over finances. I speak supernatural provision. I speak unexpected income. I speak doors of opportunity opening. I speak favor with men and favor [music] with institutions. I command debts to be canceled. I command lack to be replaced with abundance. I command poverty to be replaced with prosperity. Not just enough to get by, but overflow. Not just survival, but abundance. Not just making it, but thriving. Let the windows of heaven be opened >> [music] >> right now according to Malachi 3:10. Let blessings be poured out that there will not be room enough to receive. Let the devourer be rebuked for the sake of those who honor God with their substance. Let supernatural ideas and strategies be released for business breakthroughs and financial increase. Let divine connections be made that will lead to business deals, job offers, contracts, and opportunities that have never been available before. God of Elijah, show up in the lives of those under financial pressure just like you showed up for the widow of Zarephath whose oil and flour never ran out. Show up like you showed up for Elisha's widow whose oil multiplied until all the vessels were full. Show up like you showed up for Peter when there were so many fish that the net almost broke. Show up right now and do what only you can do. I speak to stubborn situations right now that have refused to change, situations that have been going on for years, situations that have made people lose hope, situations that have caused people to question whether God even hears their prayers. I decree and declare by the authority of heaven that this is the season of sudden change. What has been stubborn for years will suddenly shift. What has been resistant will suddenly yield. What has been closed will suddenly open. What has been delayed will suddenly manifest. The Bible says in Isaiah 43:19, "Behold, I will do a new thing. Now it shall spring forth. Shall ye not know it? I will even make a way in the wilderness and rivers in the desert." God is about to do a new thing in your life. The old patterns are breaking. The old cycles are ending. The old limitations are being removed. New doors opening. New opportunities are coming. New seasons are beginning. Father, I pray for those who are under pressure because of what they see in the natural. The situation looks impossible. The diagnosis looks permanent. The circumstance looks irreversible. But, Father, you are the God of the impossible. You are the God who specializes in hopeless cases. You are the God who makes dead things come back to life. So, right now, I speak life into dead situations. I speak hope into hopeless circumstances. I speak possibility into impossible cases. Let what looks finished begin again. Let what looks dead resurrect. Let what looks impossible become possible. For you are the God who said in Luke 1:37, "For with God nothing shall be impossible." What is impossible with man is possible with God. What doctors cannot do, you can do. What human effort cannot accomplish, your power can accomplish. [music] What natural means cannot achieve, supernatural intervention can achieve. I come against the spirit [music] of discouragement that has been following some of you. Every time you try to get up, discouragement pushes you back down. Every time you start to have hope, discouragement whispers that nothing is going to change. Every time you begin to believe God, discouragement reminds you of past failures. But, I decree and declare that the spirit of discouragement is broken right now in Jesus' name. You shall not be discouraged. You shall not give up. You shall not quit. You shall not throw in the towel. The Bible says in Galatians 6:2-9, "And let us not be weary in well-doing, for in due season we shall reap if we faint not." Your due season is coming. Your harvest is coming. Your breakthrough is coming. And it's closer than you think. What you have been praying for is about to manifest. What you have been believing God for is about to show up. What you have been waiting for is about to arrive. Father, release strength to those who are weary. Isaiah 40:2-29 says, "He giveth power to the faint, and to them that have no might, he increaseth strength." There are people listening to this prayer who are physically, emotionally, and spiritually exhausted. They have nothing left to give. They feel like they cannot go on one more day. But, Father, I pray that you would renew their strength right now. Touch their bodies. Touch their minds. Touch their spirits. Let fresh energy flow through them. Let fresh grace flow through them. Let fresh hope flow through them. Those who have been running and getting weary, let them run and not be weary. >> [music] >> Those who have been walking and fainting, let them walk and not faint. Let them mount up with wings as eagles. Let them rise above their circumstances. Let them soar above their problems. Let them fly above the pressure. I speak release over captives right now. Everyone who has been held captive by the enemy through pressure, I declare your release in Jesus' name. The Bible says in Luke 4:18, "The spirit of the Lord is upon me, because he hath anointed me to preach the gospel to the poor." "He hath sent me to heal the brokenhearted." "To preach deliverance to the captives." "And recovering of sight to the blind, to set at liberty them that are bruised." Right now, the anointing to set captives free is at work. Chains are breaking. Bondages are being destroyed. Captivity is being reversed. Where the enemy has held you hostage through fear, you are released. Where the enemy has held you bound through guilt and shame, you are released. Where the enemy has held you in prison through addictions and habits, you are released. Where the enemy has held you trapped through wrong relationships and wrong associations, you are released. You are free. You are delivered. You are liberated in the mighty name of Jesus. Father, I thank you because as we pray, things are shifting in the realm of the spirit. Angels are being dispatched. [music] Demonic assignments are being canceled. Doors are being opened. Pathways are being cleared. Burdens are being lifted. Yolks are being destroyed. And by the time this prayer is over, people will physically feel lighter. They will feel the weight lifting off their shoulders. They will feel hope rising in their hearts. They will feel faith being restored in their spirits. So, we receive it by faith right now. We don't wait to see it first. We believe it first, and then we will see it. Hebrews 11:1-1 says, "Now faith is the substance of things hoped for, the evidence of things not seen." We call those things that be not as though they were. We speak to mountains and command them to be removed. We speak to situations and command them to change. We speak to pressure and command it to lift. And we believe that as we speak by faith, heaven is responding, angels are moving, and miracles are being released. Now, in the mighty name of Jesus, I seal this prayer with the blood of Jesus. I cover everyone who has prayed this prayer with the blood of Jesus. I declare that no weapon formed against you shall prosper. Every tongue that rises against you in judgment, you shall condemn. This is your heritage as a servant of the Lord. Your righteousness is of the Lord according to Isaiah 54:2-17. I declare that you are blessed going out and blessed coming in. You are the head and not the tail. You are above only and not beneath. You are more than a conqueror through Christ who loves you. Greater is he that is in you than he that is in the world. No evil shall befall you. Neither shall any plague come near your dwelling. The Lord is your shepherd, you shall not want. The Lord is your light and your salvation, whom shall you fear? The Lord is the strength of your life, of whom shall you be afraid? Father, we thank you because the pressure is lifting right now. We thank you because relief is coming. We thank you because breakthrough is manifesting. We thank you because victory is ours. We give you all the glory. We give you all the honor. We give you all the praise. For you alone are worthy. In the mighty, powerful, matchless, excellent, wonderful name of Jesus Christ of Nazareth, we have prayed. And everybody who believes, let your amen be loud and let your faith be strong. Amen and amen.
